name: DeFi-liquidity inflow momentum — ride trend backed by capital entering crypto (long spot)
rationale: CROSS-METRIC (defi_tvl x momentum), an on-chain LIQUIDITY confirmation no existing spec uses. Price momentum cannot distinguish a move funded by genuine capital INFLOW from a thin reflexive drift. defi_tvl (total value locked across DeFi) is a free, daily on-chain read on whether real capital is FLOWING INTO crypto: a rising TVL means liquidity and risk appetite are entering the ecosystem, the macro fuel that sustains trends; a falling TVL is capital redeeming out, where momentum fades. This is the on-chain analogue of oi-buildup-confirmed-momentum (which uses perp OI) but on an ORTHOGONAL axis — DeFi capital is spot/protocol liquidity, not leveraged perp notional. Mechanism before data: long spot when defi_tvl crosses UP through a fitted level (capital inflow regime confirmed by the direction of the cross) AND price momentum is positive; exit when TVL turns down (liquidity tide reversing) or barriers fire. Distinct from oi-buildup (perp leverage axis), cross-market-dollar-weak-momentum (FX regime), and stablecoin-flow ideas (not yet ingested). Disconfirmer 1: drop the TVL arm — if bare momentum matches the deflated Sharpe, the liquidity confirmation adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: TVL rises mechanically when token prices rise (TVL is denominated in USD of deposited tokens), so the cross_up could be a price proxy; if replacing the momentum arm with a price-DECLINE arm flips the edge sign, TVL is tracking price, not flow. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): defi_tvl is daily next-day-available; net of ~20bps the trend must clear. tier0 defi_tvl + tier0 ret_Nd, fresh prod data (DefiLlama), unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: defi_tvl crosses up (real capital flowing into crypto) WHILE price momentum is positive — a liquidity-backed trend, ridden on spot
